title: AI Sends 43% of Tally's New Users
caption:
The biggest growth channel of 2026 is one you can't buy ads on.

Tally crossed $6M ARR this week — bootstrapped, team of 10, six years in. And 43% of their new users now arrive from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity. For five years the loop was word of mouth plus the "Made with Tally" badge. That loop still runs. It's just not first anymore.

I keep going back and forth on this one. I've spent months on SEO that an assistant now answers over my head, and Marie's own line is that a model update could reshuffle recommendations overnight. So it's the best channel I have and the one I control least.

Where did your last 10 users come from?
